en.title: Designing Tools for Claude: Why Thin API Wrappers Make Weak Agent Tools
en.subtitle: One tool per endpoint makes Claude page, chain and juggle IDs. Shape tools around tasks and return only what the next step needs.

import types

NS = types.SimpleNamespace
_CUSTOMERS = [
    NS(id="9f1c2e7a-4b1d-4c55-9a0e-2d7f61c0b8aa", name="Dana Levi",
       email="dana.levi@example.com", since="2021-04-02"),
    NS(id="0b7e3f19-8c2a-4e6b-b1d4-5a9c2e8f7d31", name="Dana Levin",
       email="dlevin@example.com", since="2023-09-17"),
]


def _search_customers(query, limit=5):
    q = query.lower()
    exact = [c for c in _CUSTOMERS if q in (c.name.lower(), c.email)]
    return (exact or [c for c in _CUSTOMERS if q in c.name.lower()])[:limit]


def _list_transactions(customer_id, limit=20):
    rows = [NS(date="2026-03-04", amount="49.00 USD", status="charged"),
            NS(date="2026-03-04", amount="49.00 USD", status="charged"),
            NS(date="2026-02-04", amount="49.00 USD", status="charged")]
    return rows[:limit]


def _list_notes(customer_id, status="open"):
    return [NS(text="Customer reports a duplicate charge after a timeout.")]


crm = NS(search_customers=_search_customers,
         list_transactions=_list_transactions, list_notes=_list_notes)
